scope: Bounded read-only audit of 15 current independently accepted global review cases, plus one additional Neal's Yard case explicitly requested by the parent. Focus: markets, reformulations and wine vintages. No retrieval, edits to other partitions, source mutation or review resampling.

cases.name: Antipodes Kiwi Seed Oil Eye Cream
cases.finding: Current Antipodes Kiwi Seed Oil Eye Cream vegan certification was accepted by name/30ml, but the retained source formula differs from the stored complete INCI.
cases.stored_evidence: Stored ingredients include glyceryl stearate and do not list palmitic acid, lauric acid or myristic acid.
cases.source_evidence: Current source instead lists glyceryl stearate SE and adds palmitic acid, lauric acid and myristic acid; ingredient ordering also differs.
cases.broader_assurance: Only the current named product certification is supplied. No retained whole-brand/all-formulas assertion resolves the stored formula.
cases.recommended_action: Conservatively withhold this candidate from application unless existing broader retained evidence independently covers the stored formula; do not resample to overturn the observed discrepancy.

cases.name: E45 Hydrating Face Serum with Hyaluronic Acid for Dry & Sensitive Skin
cases.finding: Exact UK E45 Face Hydrating Serum 30ml has the same complete ingredient list and explicit vegan statement. No extension to other E45 creams containing lanolin was made.

cases.name: Simple Wipes Daily Detox Matte
cases.finding: Simple UK source vegan wording is in the named Daily Skin Detox Matte & Clear wipes section, matching the stored matte/detox identity, thyme/zinc/witch-hazel actives and biodegradable fibre description. No other wipe section is substituted.

cases.name: Sanex Expert Skin Health Moisturising Bubble Bath Soak
cases.finding: Sanex UK exact named bath foam has an explicit vegan statement. The complete source ingredient set matches the stored set despite ordering differences in the ingredient-purpose table.

cases.name: NIVEA Soft Moisturiser Cream for Face Hands & Body,
cases.finding: Reformulated UK NIVEA Soft claim is matched by the complete stored current INCI, including the new fatty-acid/vegetable-oil system. The 200ml snapshot and 50ml source share that formula; no older lanolin formula was accepted.

cases.name: Sukin Natural Cleansing Shampoo
cases.finding: Sukin UK own brand-values publication explicitly covers animal derivatives and processes for the brand generally. The stored Australian-made Sukin Natural Balance/Cleansing Shampoo is within that brand scope; no product/market exception appears.

cases.name: Aveeno Skin Relief Moisturising Body Wash for Very Dry Skin
cases.finding: Exact UK Aveeno Skin Relief Body Wash claim matches the full 500ml stored ingredient sequence and source PR-0000409. No market or reformulation mismatch found.

cases.name: M&S Bordeaux Merlot
cases.finding: UK 75cl Bordeaux Merlot source is vintage 2023; snapshot names the same 100% Merlot wine without a conflicting vintage or blend. No concrete conflict found; approval is not a claim about all vintages.

cases.name: M&S Classics Cote De Provence Rose
cases.finding: UK 75cl Classics Provence rosé source is vintage 2025. Snapshot 9.8 units/75cl accords with the source 13% ABV, and no conflicting vintage or complete grape blend is stored. No concrete conflict found.

cases.name: M&S Coteaux Varois en Provence Rose Small Bottle
cases.finding: The accepted M&S Coteaux Varois en Provence Rosé 250ml source is explicitly vintage 2025 and publishes a complete grape blend incompatible with the stored blend description.
cases.stored_evidence: The stored product says it is made with Cinsault, Grenache, Syrah, Mourvèdre and Rolle.
cases.source_evidence: The 2025 source gives a complete 100% blend: 18% Cinsault, 47% Grenache, 1% Carignan, 26% Syrah, 1% Rolle, 4% Cabernet Sauvignon, 1% Grenache Blanc, 1% Ugni Blanc and 1% Semillon. No Mourvèdre is included.
cases.broader_assurance: The only selected source is the current named wine product page; no all-vintages manufacturer assurance was supplied.
cases.recommended_action: Conservatively withhold this stored product from application because the current vintage/blend statement does not establish its recorded wine blend.

cases.name: Flint Vineyard Charmat Rose
cases.finding: UK Charmat Rosé exact 75cl identity. Source identifies base vintage 2025 and lot CHR25; snapshot states no vintage, lot or contradictory blend. No concrete conflict found, but the retained statement is not represented as all-vintages assurance.

cases.name: Avene Soothing Eye Contour Cream for very sensitive skin
cases.finding: Exact UK Avène Soothing Eye Contour Cream 10ml source has the same complete ingredient sequence as the snapshot and a product-specific no-animal-derived-ingredients statement.

cases.name: Dr Organic Evoke Awaken Radiance Day Cream
cases.finding: Dr Organic Evoke Awaken Day Cream has a smaller but concrete INCI difference: the current source adds potassium sorbate, absent from the stored complete list.
cases.stored_evidence: Stored preservation list has sodium dehydroacetate, sodium benzoate and benzyl alcohol, with no potassium sorbate.
cases.source_evidence: Current full INCI inserts potassium sorbate between sodium benzoate and benzyl alcohol. The page also has a contradictory night-cream teaser, although main title, ingredient profile and product images identify Awaken Day Cream.
cases.broader_assurance: The selected source is product-specific and does not explicitly state that all historical Evoke formulas are vegan.
cases.recommended_action: Parent should assess this narrower discrepancy before application. It is a concrete formula/source-copy inconsistency, not proof of non-vegan status or a claim that every disclosure difference is a reformulation.

cases.name: Neal's Yard Revitalising Orange Flower Conditioner
cases.finding: Historical Spring 2024 UK manufacturer catalogue explicitly marks the exact Revitalising Orange Flower Conditioner 200ml VEGAN. No conflicting newer formula or product identity is established by the retained inputs.

cases.name: Antipodes Diem Vitamin C Pigment-Correcting Water Cream
cases.finding: Current Antipodes Diem Water Cream vegan certification was accepted by exact name/60ml despite substantial changes between the stored and source ingredient lists.
cases.stored_evidence: Stored formula uses sodium ascorbyl phosphate, aloe leaf juice and potassium sorbate.
cases.source_evidence: Current source uses 3-O-ethyl ascorbic acid and aloe leaf juice powder, omits potassium sorbate, and adds cetearyl alcohol, sunflower oil, tocopherol, maltodextrin, multiple gums and other ingredients.
cases.broader_assurance: Only the current named product certification is supplied. No retained whole-brand/all-formulas assertion resolves the stored formula.
cases.recommended_action: Conservatively withhold this candidate from application; the current formula claim does not establish the stored formula.

cases.name: Neal's Yard Mint & Bergamot Hand Lotion
cases.finding: The Neal's Yard current Hand Lotion formula differs by actual ingredients, not just INCI ordering or botanical synonyms. The exact-name/200ml vegan certification does not expressly bridge the stored formula.
cases.stored_evidence: Stored full INCI contains no Citrus aurantium bergamia/bergamot peel oil, sodium levulinate or terpineol. The stored description mentions bergamot despite its absence from that INCI.
cases.source_evidence: Current INCI adds bergamot peel oil, sodium levulinate and terpineol; glycerin and aloe move substantially within the list. Botanical synonym differences such as spearmint naming were not treated as separate ingredients.
cases.broader_assurance: The sole selected source is the current Garden Mint & Bergamot Hand Lotion product page. It does not explicitly confirm older formulations or all Neal's Yard products.
cases.recommended_action: Conservatively withhold unless existing retained evidence explicitly bridges the stored formula. The added ingredients are not themselves proof of non-vegan status; the issue is unsupported transfer of current certification across differing complete lists.

coverage.conclusion: Pending and blocked are retained as unfinished categories. Missing records, if any, are counted pending. No claim of exhaustive completion is supported. This is a structural coverage check, not a fresh content audit of every no_confirmation decision.

limits: These findings concern whether current manufacturer evidence covers the stored product. They do not classify any product non-vegan. Counts are a timestamped snapshot while the parent may still finalise application exclusions.
